sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You know what a lot of fighters forget? How to fight at distance. Our Arenas aren't huge, sure, but there's still room to stretch things out. Don't waste that advantage. A talented fighter has to be good at everything!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 50 enemies while using marksman rifles

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +26,000 EXP
- +300 DMRs skill points
- 15 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
